comment:
* Interface for managing the items in a menu.
 *
 * This version extends the one available in the framework to ensures that any necessary
 * elements added in later versions of the framework, are available for all platforms.
 *
 * @see android.view.Menu

variables.name: USER_MASK
variables.comment: * This is the part of an order integer that the user can provide.

variables.name: USER_SHIFT
variables.comment: * Bit shift of the user portion of the order integer.

variables.name: CATEGORY_MASK
variables.comment: * This is the part of an order integer that supplies the category of the item.

variables.name: CATEGORY_SHIFT
variables.comment: * Bit shift of the category portion of the order integer.

variables.name: SUPPORTED_MODIFIERS_MASK
variables.comment: * A mask of all supported modifiers for MenuItem's keyboard shortcuts

variables.name: FLAG_KEEP_OPEN_ON_SUBMENU_OPENED
variables.comment: * Flag which stops the Menu being closed when a sub menu is opened

methods.name: void setGroupDividerEnabled(boolean enabled)
methods.comment:
* Enable or disable the group dividers.
     *
     * @param enabled True if enabled.
